hero.desc: We are your reliable partner for international logistics solutions, professional customs clearance, modern warehousing services, and the trade of high-quality food and beverage products from Europe and around the world.
s1.label: LOGISTICS
s1.title: Logistics Services
s1.text: AtlantSovt offers comprehensive logistics services in the European Union, Eastern Europe, the Middle East, and Asia:
s1.f1: Consulting on transportation and customs clearance
s1.f2: Selection of appropriate means of transport (own or third-party vehicles)
s1.f4: Transport of heavy and oversized cargo
s1.f5: Consolidation of goods in our own warehouses
s1.f7: Warehousing services (own warehouses in Leipzig, Germany)
s1.f8: Customs warehouse (own customs warehouses in Leipzig)
s1.f9: Excise warehouse / Tax warehouse (own tax warehouses in Leipzig)
s1.f10: Application of excise stamps, labels, and product stickers
s1.text2: In Eastern Europe, we also offer the following services:
s1.text3: Since all these services are provided by a single company across multiple countries, we can offer you a complete spectrum of logistics solutions in Eastern and Western Europe as well as in the Middle East and Asia.
s2.label: CUSTOMS SERVICES
s2.title: Customs Services
s2.text: Thanks to our customs and excise licences, AVETAR Logistic GmbH can handle all customs procedures for your goods:
s2.f3: Opening and closing of T1 transit procedures
s2.f4: Opening and closing of excise duty procedures
s2.f5: Issuance of EUR.1 certificates of origin for European goods
s2.text2: Thanks to our qualified and experienced team, we are able to handle any type of shipment professionally.
s3.label: WAREHOUSE SERVICES
s3.title: Warehouse Services
s3.text: AVETAR Logistic GmbH can offer you the full range of warehousing services at our facility in D-04425 Taucha, Pönitzer Weg 2:
s3.f1: Storage of any goods in standard warehouses
s3.f2: Storage of any goods in customs warehouses (we hold a licence to operate customs warehouses and store goods under customs supervision)
s3.f3: Storage of any goods in excise warehouses (we hold a licence for excise warehouses and storage of goods under excise supervision)
s3.text2: Thanks to our comprehensive package of customs and excise licences, we are able to store all goods under customs and excise supervision in our warehouses.
s4.label: TRADE
s4.title: Alcohol & Food Trade
s4.text: AVETAR Logistic GmbH acts as a technical importer (Importer of Record) for alcoholic beverages, non-alcoholic beverages, and food products from around the world:
s4.f2: Trade in wines and sparkling wines
s4.text2: We can offer you both our own product line and handle the sale of goods of your choice. We take care of everything on a turnkey basis: communication with the seller, customs clearance of goods, issuance of EUR.1, labelling of excise goods (excise stamps and translation), logistics, and customs clearance in Ukraine.
ft.desc: Your reliable partner for logistics, customs clearance, warehousing services, and international trade from Europe and the world.
